headline: Record revenue and operating profit, net profit falls
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 104.6T (+328% y/y) and operating profit KRW 83.3T (+632% y/y), while net income fell 57.9% q/q to KRW 39.5T.
summary_long: Preliminary results put revenue above KRW 100T for the first time, with an operating margin near 80%. Net income of KRW 39.5T was far below operating profit and down from KRW 93.8T in the prior quarter. Third-party coverage reports the figures as unaudited. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary, unaudited results. Net income is the shard value (sources quote KRW 39.5T to 39.8T). Shard operating income (KRW 89.7T) does not match the reported KRW 83.3T and is not used.
